entries.core_meaning_english: the two letters indicate gathering/clustering in something, along with smallness and lightness

entries.core_meaning: مِشْيَةٌ يُثِير فيها الرّاجِلُ التّرابَ إذا مَشَى، وهو منحوتٌ من كلمتين: نَقَثَ (الإسراع في المَشْي) ونَقَل (نَقْل القوائم)
entries.core_meaning_english: a gait/walk in which the walker kicks up dust as he goes; a blend-word formed from two words: 'naqatha' (hastening in walking) and 'naql' (moving the limbs/feet)

variances.meaning_english: a walking gait that kicks up dust

entries.notes: This entry continues from a previous page (root began earlier); this page only has its tail end. Root falls under the chapter 'باب ما جاء من كلام العرب على أكثر من ثلاثة أحرف أوله نون' (words of more than three letters beginning with noon), so treated as a quadriliteral blend (منحوت) rather than a standard triliteral root. Footnote attributes the verse to Sakhr ibn 'Umayr per Lisān al-'Arab (نقفل), also cited unattributed in al-Muhkam; preceding line given as 'قاربت أمشي القعولى والفنجله'. Corrected: removed a '(تكملة)' marker the prior extraction had prepended to core_meaning — that word is not printed on the page.

entries.core_meaning: النِّمْرُقَة: الوِسادة. وهذا مما زيدت فيه القاف، إنما هي من النَّمِرَة وهي الكساء المخطط
entries.core_meaning_english: a cushion; the qaf here is an added (extra) letter — the word is really from 'namirah', the striped cloak/garment

variances.meaning_english: a cushion/pillow

entries.notes: Continuation entry closing the chapter of quadriliteral noon-words; text notes the qaf is an augment on the root نمر (النَّمِرَة = striped cloak). Immediately followed by the colophon 'تم كتاب النون' (end of Kitab al-Nun, p.735 of the original edition) and end-of-volume notice: end of part 5 of Maqayees al-Lugha, part 6 begins with Kitab al-Ha'. Corrected: sarf_pattern changed from an invented label 'مزيد فيه (زيادة القاف)' to empty — the page text says 'زيدت فيه القاف' as a description, not a named morphological category term (unlike المضاعف/الأجوف/etc.), so per the extraction rule it should not be filled.
